name: Greeter
overview: Scripture highlights the role of a greeter as one who embodies hospitality and love within the body of Christ, reflecting God's blessing and care as seen in Numbers 6:24. Believers are called to share joy, peace, and hope through the power of the Holy Spirit (Romans 15:13) and to be unified in love and purpose (Philippians 2:2). This welcoming spirit aligns with the heart of God’s revelation, inviting others to experience His salvation and fellowship (John 3:16; Revelation 1:1). Practical expressions include meeting the needs of fellow believers with generosity and hospitality (Romans 12:13).
